mensajes.limite: Preparation does not create the unit. Application requires external approval and configuration; the receipt and attempt audit are confirmed only after COMMIT.
mensajes.uso_invalido: Provide the plan material, separate source, plan destination and message catalog. Add --cotejar to check an existing plan.
mensajes.fuente_insegura: A private file cannot be read. Use files up to 64 KiB in a private directory outside the repository.
mensajes.fuente_invalida: The plan or its source does not meet the initial unit contract or has expired. Check references, catalog, dates and source hash.
mensajes.plan_inseguro: The private plan cannot be read for comparison.
mensajes.plan_divergente: The existing plan differs from the material and source or the destination is unsafe. It has not been overwritten.
mensajes.plan_preparado: The unit plan is prepared and its hash has been calculated. Keep it for review.
mensajes.operacion_no_confirmada: The operation has not been confirmed. No receipt or audit record is presented as persisted.
mensajes.commit_no_confirmado: COMMIT could not be confirmed. The result is indeterminate. Keep the plan and request a check before acting.
mensajes.acuse_inseguro: The acknowledgement destination is unsafe or already exists. Choose another private file before sending the operation.
mensajes.acuse_no_guardado: COMMIT is confirmed, but the acknowledgement could not be saved. Keep the plan to recover the original receipt with a new acknowledgement file.
mensajes.unidad_confirmada: The operation is confirmed and its acknowledgement has been saved.
mensajes.unidad_rechazada: The database rejected the operation and confirmed its attempt record. Consult the private acknowledgement.
mensajes.unidad_no_disponible: The operation ended with an error and its attempt record was confirmed. Consult the private acknowledgement.
mensajes.aplicacion_entrada_invalida: The private connection or approval does not meet the contract.
